name: Sligo Yoga Centre
reason: No own website found in two searches: results were only directory and listing pages (Golden Pages, playsport, tripaligner) and press articles. The address sligoyogacentre.ie appears only as an email domain on the Iyengar Yoga Ireland list, and a domain may not be guessed. Worth a manual look: founded on Castle Street, Sligo in 1994 by Helen Gillan as Ireland's first fully equipped Iyengar studio, run by Tara McEvoy since 2017 (Sligo Weekender, 2022).
